name: Luna Capability Registry
notes: Capability Module is the minimal packaging, iteration, and acceptance unit in Luna.
Subsystem/component/policy/protocol/adapter/runner/verifier are internal assets unless explicitly promoted with governance evidence.
This registry is foundation-only and does not create runtime loading services.

capabilities.responsibility: Coordinate candidate-only field perception planning and controlled visual invocation handoff from Field Perception to Vision Manager to Model Manager to Observation Manager.

input_contract.summary: field state, task context, observation summaries, resource budget, uncertainty/conflict state, and invocation history

output_contract.summary: field perception plan plus candidate-only visual invocation handoff result with diagnostics, trace, replay, and result link contract

known_limitations: no real model execution, no real visual evidence generation, no field state write, no runtime loop

capabilities.responsibility: Reduce admitted field events to field state candidate and read projection candidate under policy and governance boundaries.

output_contract.summary: field state candidate, projection candidate, diagnostics, trace, replay key

known_limitations: no state persistence or action execution

capabilities.responsibility: Govern model admission, capability-first routing, ownership/resource evaluation, and lifecycle planning in controlled scope.

output_contract.summary: model selection/lifecycle/fallback candidates with diagnostics, trace, replay

known_limitations: no direct runtime execution or state mutation

capabilities.responsibility: Coordinate task orchestration lifecycle, dependency routing, interruption/recovery candidates, and governed handoff through consolidated module API.

input_contract.summary: task request and governance handoff signals

output_contract.summary: task orchestration decisions and handoff records

known_limitations: no direct runtime dispatch or state mutation

capabilities.responsibility: Assemble unified candidate-only observation chain from task/scene/attention/region to vision+ocr evidence association and admission handoff.

input_contract.summary: observation request candidates with task/scene/attention/region/temporal constraints

output_contract.summary: observation candidate and permission admission handoff candidate with diagnostics/trace/replay

known_limitations: no fact admission, no field state write, no provider runtime invocation

capabilities.responsibility: Assemble task-aware visual input candidates, model handoff candidates, and composed visual evidence under strict candidate-only boundaries.

input_contract.summary: vision observation request, attention target, frame quality, ownership and version snapshots

output_contract.summary: visual evidence candidates, model handoff candidate, diagnostics, trace/replay

known_limitations: candidate-only module; no real provider runtime execution
no state mutation, fact admission, or action execution

capabilities.responsibility: Assemble candidate-only OCR input/governance/engine/evidence chain and emit structured OCR evidence envelope with diagnostics and deterministic trace/replay.

input_contract.summary: OCR request, source/frame refs, region candidates, and optional human correction candidate input

output_contract.summary: raw OCR evidence + layout/reading-order/attribution/enhancement/correction/crossmodal candidates + structured evidence envelope + diagnostics + trace/replay

known_limitations: no direct provider runtime/model execution/state mutation/fact admission

capabilities.responsibility: Manage voice and speech guidance pathways under governance controls.

input_contract.summary: voice dialogue, speech text, and provider request candidates

output_contract.summary: speech output plane candidates, diagnostics, trace, and replay outputs

known_limitations: candidate-only processing only; no real ASR/TTS/VOP runtime
speaker identity and ASR outputs remain non-factual candidates

capabilities.responsibility: Provide controlled read-only field state projection and query access over reducer-compatible state candidates without mutation, fact admission, or runtime dispatch.

input_contract.summary: field state read query plus controlled runtime request

output_contract.summary: field state read result plus controlled runtime envelope

capabilities.responsibility: Provide governed working memory skeleton services for midplatform workflows.
Resolve candidate-only permission and admission eligibility for evidence/model/protocol/capability/state/action/runtime requests under governance boundaries.

output_contract.summary: admission decision candidates, rejection reasons, review requirements, diagnostics, trace, replay

known_limitations: no fact admission, state write, model/action execution, or runtime dispatch

capabilities.responsibility: Manage execution-ready action planning, release governance, and controlled action boundaries.

input_contract.summary: planned action candidates and governance approvals

capabilities.responsibility: Assemble candidate-only navigation request, route state, progress, evidence, risk, guidance, arrival, and task/speech handoff outputs.

input_contract.summary: navigation request candidates with route/progress/evidence/context snapshots

output_contract.summary: navigation route/risk/guidance/arrival/task+speech handoff candidates with diagnostics and trace/replay

known_limitations: no real map/gps/camera/reroute runtime side effects

capabilities.responsibility: Provide system health governance and diagnostics state framing.
Manage protocol registry, checker, and protocol health contracts across midplatform flows.

input_contract.summary: protocol operation request candidates with version and governance snapshots

output_contract.summary: protocol governance/compatibility/admission candidates with diagnostics and trace/replay

known_limitations: no runtime protocol loading or registry mutation

capabilities.responsibility: Validate controlled cross-module main-chain handoff integrity from Task Manager through Field State Reducer under candidate-only boundaries.

input_contract.summary: synthetic system-chain scenarios and cross-module handoff assertions

output_contract.summary: system integration validation report with scenario outcomes, boundary checks, and trace/replay evidence
